title: Start Here
description: A survival pack about useful preparation and expeditions. Collect twelve different End Remastered eyes, reach the End, defeat the dragon, and assemble the Survival Star. Other sections are open from the start.

title: Something to Work With
description: Obtain eight logs of any type. Set up wherever you want; there is no required base location.

title: A Working Surface
description: Obtain a crafting table. JEI shows recipes, including the pack changes.

title: First Iron
description: Obtain four iron ingots for equipment and tools.

title: Somewhere to Return
description: Obtain any bed and establish a respawn point before a long trip.

title: Bring a Shield
description: Obtain a shield. Combo adds timed parries and stamina; its Mod Menu settings explain the controls. Practice blocking before your next expedition.

title: Pack for the Trip
description: Obtain a Backpacked backpack. Its pack recipe uses leather, canvas and bronze; check JEI.

title: Spare Building Supplies
description: Optional exchange: deliver 16 cobblestone and 8 oak logs for 8 coal. Your equipment progression does not depend on this contract.

title: Underground Workshop
description: Find the Spelunker Update ores, build a foundry, and turn underground discoveries into expedition equipment. Check JEI for foundry and smithing recipes.

title: Tin
description: Smelt tin ore into an ingot. Keep some copper for bronze.

title: Nickel
description: Find and smelt nickel. It is used in plating and alloys.

title: Silver
description: Find and smelt silver. It becomes useful for electrum.

title: The Foundry
description: Build a foundry. It processes the mod's alloys using ingredients and lava.

title: First Alloy
description: Produce four bronze ingots. Check JEI for the foundry ingredients.

title: Put Bronze to Work
description: Obtain a bronze pickaxe. Put it to work on your next mining trip.

title: A Miner's Helmet
description: Obtain a miner's helmet before your next deep expedition.

title: Nickel Plating
description: Produce nickel plating and inspect the armor upgrades it enables.

title: Invar
description: Produce four invar ingots. Some End-eye recipes now use the alloy.

title: Electrum
description: Produce four electrum ingots. It connects equipment, enchanting and eye crafting.

title: Look More Closely
description: Obtain a prospector lens and take it on a mining trip.

title: Fishing
description: Fishing Frenzy adds species, bait and equipment. Keep a few different catches: they contribute to the crafted Exotic Eye. Check bait and rod tooltips for the controls.

title: A Fishing Rod
description: Obtain a fishing rod and find open water.

title: Bait
description: Obtain worm bait. Use the rod and bait controls described by Fishing Frenzy.

title: First Catch
description: Reel in a fish or fishing loot with a rod.

title: Carp
description: Catch a carp and keep a few for crafting and supplies.

title: Bream
description: Catch or obtain a bream. Keep one for the Exotic Eye recipe.

title: Better Tackle
description: Obtain the deluxe fishing rod. Its pack recipe uses bronze and string.

title: Better Bait
description: Obtain deluxe bait. Check its tooltip before using it.

title: A Nautilus Shell
description: Obtain a nautilus shell by fishing, trading or another legitimate source.

title: Fish for Supplies
description: Optional exchange: deliver 4 carp for 4 iron ingots. Keep your eye-crafting ingredients before submitting. This exchange is optional.

title: Food and Supplies
description: Build a useful kitchen with Farmer's Delight. These goals are optional preparation; you do not need a checklist of meals to enter the End.

title: A Kitchen Knife
description: Obtain a flint knife. Use it to prepare ingredients at a cutting board.

title: Cutting Board
description: Obtain a cutting board. Check JEI for ingredients you can cut.

title: A More Varied Garden
description: Obtain cabbage, tomato and rice. Grow them so expedition food is renewable.

title: Cooking Pot
description: Obtain a cooking pot and set up its heat source.

title: A Proper Meal
description: Eat Farmer's Delight beef stew. Consult JEI for the cooking-pot recipe.

title: Use the Catch
description: Prepare or obtain fish stew. Check JEI for suitable fish.

title: Meals for the Road
description: Optional exchange: deliver 2 beef stews for 8 arrows and 4 coal. Finish equipping yourself before donating food.

title: Equipment
description: Pick equipment that suits the expedition. Combo adds melee finishers, parries, stamina and dodging. Prepare for close fights and long journeys.

title: Know Your Opponents
description: Defeat a zombie, skeleton and spider. Try Combo's timing and shield controls while fighting.

title: Carry Ammunition
description: Obtain a Sagittary quiver and check its tooltip for the controls.

title: A Ranged Upgrade
description: Obtain a compound bow. Check JEI for its recipe.

title: Enchanting Table
description: Obtain an enchanting table. Books, lapis and experience support the next equipment tier.

title: First Enchantment
description: Enchant an item at an enchanting table. Bring lapis lazuli and enough experience.

title: Diamond Protection
description: Obtain a diamond chestplate before choosing your hardest expedition.

title: Maintain Your Equipment
description: Obtain an anvil for repair, naming and book application.

title: Overworld Expeditions
description: Explore at your own pace. Look for dungeons, taverns and landmarks, and bring back supplies for your next trip.

title: Take a Map
description: Obtain a filled map. Keep track of useful places; there are no required fixed coordinates.

title: Desert Pyramid
description: Enter a desert pyramid. Check for traps before collecting its loot.

title: A Shipwreck
description: Explore a shipwreck. Maps and ocean resources can start a longer trip.

title: Buried Treasure
description: Obtain a heart of the sea. Keep it for a conduit or your final star.

title: Ocean Monument
description: Enter an ocean monument. Plan breathing, visibility and an escape route.

title: Elder Guardian
description: Defeat an elder guardian. Look for a Guardian Eye among the drops.

title: An Evoker
description: Defeat an evoker in a raid or woodland mansion. Either route counts.

title: Nether Expeditions
description: Fortress and bastion trips supply brewing, equipment and eyes. A safe route home matters more than rushing the next marker.

title: Into the Nether
description: Enter the Nether. Mark your portal before travelling far.

title: Nether Fortress
description: Enter a Nether fortress. Watch for blazes and wither skeletons.

title: Brewing Materials
description: Obtain six blaze rods. Save some for powder and a brewing stand.

title: Brewing Stand
description: Obtain a brewing stand and grow nether wart for a renewable supply.

title: Bastion
description: Enter a bastion remnant. Bring gold armor and plan around piglin brutes.

title: Ancient Debris to Netherite
description: Obtain a netherite ingot. Use it at a smithing table to improve your equipment.

title: The Wither
description: Defeat the Wither. This is an optional eye route; its nether star also contributes to the final trophy.

title: The End
description: Collect twelve DIFFERENT End Remastered eyes and use them in the stronghold portal. Four eye routes can be skipped. JEI shows the pack's deterministic recipes for Cryptic, Undead, Cold and Exotic Eyes. You can also find eyes through exploration, combat and trading.

title: Desert Pyramids
description: Search desert-pyramid loot. Obtain this eye; duplicates do not replace a different eye at the portal.

title: Fortresses
description: Search Nether-fortress loot. Obtain this eye; duplicates do not replace a different eye at the portal.

title: Cold Eye
description: Craft it from packed ice, tin and an Ender Pearl. Obtain this eye; duplicates do not replace a different eye at the portal.

title: Jungle Pyramids
description: Search jungle-pyramid loot. Obtain this eye; duplicates do not replace a different eye at the portal.

title: Buried Treasure
description: Search buried treasure chests. Obtain this eye; duplicates do not replace a different eye at the portal.

title: Evokers
description: Defeat evokers and look for a Magical Eye among the drops. Obtain this eye; duplicates do not replace a different eye at the portal.

title: Mineshafts
description: Explore mineshaft loot. Obtain this eye; duplicates do not replace a different eye at the portal.

title: Outposts
description: Investigate pillager-outpost loot. Obtain this eye; duplicates do not replace a different eye at the portal.

title: Wither Eye
description: Defeat the Wither and look for a Wither Eye among the drops. Obtain this eye; duplicates do not replace a different eye at the portal.

title: Guardian Eye
description: Defeat elder guardians and look for a Guardian Eye among the drops. Obtain this eye; duplicates do not replace a different eye at the portal.

title: Witch Eye
description: Craft it using a Witch Pupil; check JEI for the recipe. Obtain this eye; duplicates do not replace a different eye at the portal.

title: Bastions
description: Search bastion treasure. Obtain this eye; duplicates do not replace a different eye at the portal.

title: Exotic Eye
description: Craft the pack recipe combining fishing catches, an aquatic shell and electrum. Obtain this eye; duplicates do not replace a different eye at the portal.

title: Trading
description: Trade with a master cleric and look for an Evil Eye. Obtain this eye; duplicates do not replace a different eye at the portal.

title: Undead Eye
description: Craft it from a wither skeleton skull, bone blocks, invar and an Ender Pearl. Obtain this eye; duplicates do not replace a different eye at the portal.

title: Cryptic Eye
description: Craft it from diamonds, lapis, a book, electrum and an Ender Pearl. Obtain this eye; duplicates do not replace a different eye at the portal.

title: Survival Star
description: Defeat the dragon and obtain the crafted Survival Star. Its recipe combines bronze, invar, electrum, a deluxe rod, a compound bow, a heart of the sea, a nether star and dragon's breath. Assemble it to finish the pack.
